{{- $name := .name -}} {{- $class := .class -}} {{- $decorative := default true .decorative -}} {{- $title := .title -}} {{- $path := printf "static/icons/tabler/%s.svg" $name -}} {{- $svg := readFile $path -}} {{- $classAttr := "" -}} {{- if $class -}} {{- $classAttr = printf " class=\"%s\"" $class -}} {{- end -}} {{- if $decorative -}} {{- $svg = replace $svg "]*>)` (printf `$1%s` $title) $svg -}} {{- end -}} {{- end -}} {{- $svg | safeHTML -}}
